request.project_task: Create an insurance claim intake and triage workflow.
request.project_goal: Collect complete loss reports and route them for review.
request.project_description: A policyholder reports a loss, uploads evidence, and receives a case number; an adjuster triages it.

actors.name: Policyholder
actors.description: A person who holds an active insurance policy and reports a loss.

actors.name: Adjuster
actors.description: An insurance adjuster who triages claims by assigning severity and review route.

use_cases.name: Report a Loss
use_cases.goal: A policyholder reports a loss with complete details and evidence, and receives a claim number.
use_cases.trigger: The policyholder decides to report a loss.

preconditions.text: The policyholder has an active policy.

success_postconditions.text: A claim number is created and the claim is available for adjuster triage.

failure_postconditions.text: No claim number is created and the policyholder is informed of the failure.

steps.action: The policyholder identifies an active policy.
steps.expected_result: The system confirms the policy is active.

steps.action: The policyholder reports loss date, location, and description.
steps.expected_result: The system records the loss details.
The system receives the evidence files.

steps.action: The system creates a claim number for a complete report.
steps.expected_result: A claim number is generated and shown to the policyholder.

steps.action: The system detects malware in an uploaded evidence file.
steps.expected_result: The upload is rejected and the policyholder is asked to provide a clean file.

user_stories.capability: report a loss with details and evidence
user_stories.benefit: I can start my claim and receive a claim number.

system_stories.system_action: Validate policy status, record loss details, scan evidence, and create a claim number.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the report is complete and evidence is safe before issuing a claim number.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Report a Loss
Goal: A policyholder reports a loss with complete details and evidence, and receives a claim number.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The policyholder decides to report a loss.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The policyholder has an active policy.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] The policyholder identifies an active policy.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The policyholder reports loss date, location, and description.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The policyholder uploads supporting evidence.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] The system creates a claim number for a complete report.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Evidence upload fails malware scan
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Triage Claim
use_cases.goal: An adjuster assigns a severity and review route to a submitted claim.
use_cases.trigger: A claim is available for triage.

preconditions.text: A claim with a claim number exists and is pending triage.

success_postconditions.text: The claim has an assigned severity and review route.

failure_postconditions.text: The claim remains untriaged and the adjuster is notified of the failure.

steps.action: The adjuster reviews the submitted claim details and evidence.
steps.expected_result: The adjuster understands the loss report.

steps.action: The adjuster assigns a severity and review route.
steps.expected_result: The system records the severity and route on the claim.

user_stories.capability: assign severity and review route to a claim
user_stories.benefit: I can route claims appropriately for review.

system_stories.system_action: Record the adjuster-assigned severity and review route on the claim.
system_stories.responsibility: Persist triage decisions and make them available for downstream processing.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Triage Claim
Goal: An adjuster assigns a severity and review route to a submitted claim.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: A claim is available for triage.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: A claim with a claim number exists and is pending triage.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] The adjuster reviews the submitted claim details and evidence.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The adjuster assigns a severity and review route.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: View Claim Status
use_cases.goal: A policyholder views the current status of their claim.
use_cases.trigger: The policyholder wants to check the claim status.

preconditions.text: The policyholder has a claim number.

success_postconditions.text: The policyholder sees the current claim status.

failure_postconditions.text: The policyholder is informed that the claim status cannot be retrieved.

steps.action: The policyholder requests to view claim status.
steps.expected_result: The system retrieves the claim status.

steps.action: The system displays the claim status to the policyholder.
steps.expected_result: The policyholder sees the current status.

user_stories.capability: view the status of my claim
user_stories.benefit: I can stay informed about my claim progress.

system_stories.system_action: Retrieve and display the claim status for the policyholder.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate and timely claim status information.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — View Claim Status
Goal: A policyholder views the current status of their claim.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The policyholder wants to check the claim status.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The policyholder has a claim number.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] The policyholder requests to view claim status.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] The system displays the claim status to the policyholder.
Source FRs: FR-006
